subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the pink-haired anime girl whose entire visible appearance comes from <Picture 1>, a single-character design illustration. She has a short chin-length pink bob with a blunt fringe and soft inner layers, very large clear blue eyes with bright highlights, fair skin and a faint blush, a delicate white flower-petal headband across the crown of her head, a black ribbon bow with a thin black X-shaped hairpin on the right side of her hair, a black-and-white frilled maid dress with a high white lace collar and a small black bow at the throat, puffed black sleeves with white cuffs, a black corset-like overdress with scalloped white piping and three small bow buttons, and a white ruffled apron over a dark skirt with a white frill hem. Her body is rendered with natural, anatomically correct human proportions and normal limb lengths — no exaggerated or chibi ratio. The pink sparkle backdrop, the static front-facing display pose and the flat graphic rendering of <Picture 1> are not used; only her identity, hair, face and costume are transferred.
<Subject 2> is the studio interior and its props taken from <Picture 2>: a packed home-recording room with a small glowing monitor on a desk to the left, stacked rack gear and rotary knobs, large black studio speaker cabinets with visible cone drivers, dark acoustic panels above, a window on the right with pale yellow-green daylight and foliage beyond, plus the silver over-ear studio headphones and the white electric guitar with a mint-green pickguard that rest with the seated figure. Room layout, equipment placement, lighting direction, colour grade and lens character are reused exactly.
The original long-haired pink-haired girl who occupies <Picture 2> is the person being replaced. She is not reused in any way; her face, eyes, hair length and colour, body, blue jacket, white shorts, necklace and choker must never appear or blend into the result. No props are being replaced, so the headphones, guitar, desk gear and room stay as they are.

detailed_description:
The target video is a 2D anime illustration in motion: crisp cel-shaded line work with soft airbrushed skin gradients, warm yellow-green daylight raking in from the right window, cool blue-grey shadow in the equipment racks, and a slightly high-contrast, saturated finish that matches the source frame. All motion is fluid and continuous, with stable, anatomically normal limbs and no warping or strobing.

[Shot 1] The shot begins from <Picture 2> as its first frame, holding the same high-angle close framing looking down at the seated figure, the same wide-ish lens falloff at the corners and the same cluttered studio around her. <Subject 1> now occupies the centre: a pink-haired girl with a short bob, huge clear blue eyes, a white flower-petal headband and a black X hairpin, wearing the black-and-white frilled maid dress with its white lace collar, black bow and ruffled apron, her arms and legs drawn with natural proportions. She sits on the floor with her knees drawn up, both hands raised to the silver studio headphones pressed over her ears, fingers curved around the ear cups with correct joint structure. The camera drifts in a slow, subtle handheld push with a gentle roll, and she tilts her chin up toward the lens, blinks once and breaks into a small, warm smile; a few strands of her fringe shift.

[Shot 2] At 00:02.600 the camera eases back and rises slightly, keeping the same angle and colour grade, revealing more of <Subject 2> — the glowing monitor, the rack of knobs, the black speaker cabinets and the blind-lit window — and the white electric guitar with the mint-green pickguard lying across her lap. <Subject 1> slides her left hand up the guitar neck and plucks the strings once with her right hand, fingers articulating naturally, shoulders relaxing; she glances down at the strings, then back up at the camera with a pleased closed-mouth smile as warm light flares softly across the white apron. The shot settles and ends on that framing.

overall_soundscape:
Close, intimate room acoustics. A steady low hum from the monitor and rack gear, faint electrical buzz from the speakers, the soft creak and padded pressure of the headphones being adjusted, the rustle of layered cotton and lace, a single clear steel-string guitar pluck with a short natural room tail in the second half, and distant muffled outdoor ambience leaking through the window blinds. No dialogue, no voiceover.

non_diegetic_music:
A very restrained ambient score: a single warm synth pad and sparse soft piano notes at low volume, slowly swelling under the guitar pluck and fading before the shot ends, never competing with the room sound.
